title: All code should be reachable
description: Unreachable code is code that can never be executed. This usually happens when there is a return, break, continue, or raise statement before the code, or when a condition is always false. Unreachable code is dead code: it increases maintenance costs, can hide bugs, and makes the codebase harder to understand.
message: This code is unreachable and will never be executed.
impact: Unreachable code increases maintenance costs, can hide bugs, and makes the codebase harder to understand.
recommendation: Remove unreachable code or refactor the logic so that all code paths are meaningful and reachable.

noncompliant.description: The print statement is unreachable because of the return statement before it.

compliant.description: All code in this function is reachable depending on the value of x.

why_is_this_an_issue: Unreachable code is dead code. It increases maintenance costs, can hide bugs, and makes the codebase harder to understand.
how_to_fix: Remove or refactor unreachable code so that all code paths are meaningful and can be executed.
